verdict.rationale: Automation of simulation runs is a fair question for a simulator, but the evidence pack documents no built-in way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Headless server mode, the CI-oriented server package, CLI tools and configuration scripts only make runs scriptable. Any recurring schedule would depend on external host tools such as cron or CI, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
